peg_reference.notes: Ripio describes wARS as a local stablecoin collateralized 1:1 with Argentine-peso reserves.

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: wARS itself is not modeled as intrinsically yield-bearing. Separate Morpho supply positions can earn variable borrower-funded yield.

classification_notes: Fiat-reserve-backed ARS stablecoin. The reviewed sources establish 1:1 collateral and Ripio conversion rails, but not a direct legal redemption right against a resolved issuing entity.

peg_reference.notes: Ripio describes wCOP as a local stablecoin collateralized 1:1 with Colombian-peso reserves.

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: No intrinsic holder yield is established by the reviewed wCOP source set.

classification_notes: Fiat-reserve-backed COP stablecoin. The reviewed sources establish 1:1 collateral and Ripio conversion rails, but not a direct legal redemption right against a resolved issuing entity.
